fact.en: Do not confuse Chandragupta Maurya with Chandragupta I (Gupta Dynasty); they are separated by 600 years.
fact.hi: Do not confuse Chandragupta Maurya with Chandragupta I (Gupta Dynasty); they are separated by 600 years.

fact.en: Avoid the misconception that he founded the empire alone; the role of Kautilya (Chanakya) as an advisor is historically central to statecraft.
fact.hi: Avoid the misconception that he founded the empire alone; the role of Kautilya (Chanakya) as an advisor is historically central to statecraft.
